q: A 16-year-old missing girl is found in a fireworks unit; owner offers to pay family and SHO says no FIR needed. Your integrated action?
options: Register missing/child-labour/trafficking FIRs, rescue to CWC, probe detention, no compromise
Send girl back to unit as witness
expl: Missing child plus hazardous labour triggers mandatory FIR, CWC rescue, and trafficking probe.
why: Multiple protections converge on a minor. Settlement destroys evidence and repeats exploitation cycle.

q: Dalit boy detained 30 hours without production after temple-entry clash; desk says permission for night pick-up was oral. Your remedy?
options: Produce forthwith, record 24-hr lapse, validate BNSS night safeguard, register PoA obstruction if caste abuse proved
Shift him to another station to reset clock
Seek village compromise to bury lapse
expl: 24-hr production and night safeguards are mandatory.
why: Production delay makes custody illegal. Night-arrest paperwork and bias probe must be fixed together.
trapnote: Trap: resets clock by station transfer.

q: Agency road blocked: contractor without village-council consent brings EWS outsiders for jobs, local youth allege booth-threat the next day. Your mix?
options: Protect PESA consent process via SDM, verify EWS claims by norms, run preventive poll-security patrol
expl: PESA consent, EWS verification and poll security run parallel.
why: Land, quota and vote issues ignite together. Separating legal tracks prevents one dispute hijacking others.
trapnote: Trap: solves consent with lathi escort.

q: Aided minority school holds back Dalit pupils from exam; management claims absolute autonomy and SHO refuses FIR citing law-order. Your course?
options: Register PoA/exam-harassment FIR, seek DEO inquiry preserving minority administration within regulation, pursue mandamus if inaction persists
expl: Autonomy is not absolute; discrimination needs FIR.
why: Aided status allows regulation to protect pupils. Choosing writ by function cures SHO inaction without excess force.
trapnote: Trap: treats autonomy as immunity and files wrong writ.

q: Kidnapped boy traced to MLA's farmhouse; staff blocks entry, local SP delays habeas compliance, rumour says women's quota already allotted seats. Response?
options: Enforce habeas production urgently, escalate non-compliance for contempt, clarify 106th post-census position to defuse rumour
expl: Habeas demands immediate production irrespective of status.
why: Liberty outranks influence. Parallel rumour-busting on quota stops mob build-up while rescue proceeds.
trapnote: Trap: bows to office and misuses quo warranto.
